description:
The worlds you can read here. With an API-Key: the key's one world. Signed
in through a hosted client (a bearer), where this server offers one: every
world your account owns or is a member of, as your account's world list shows
them; pass one's `id` as `world` to the other read tools; a
bearer reads only, and writes need an API-Key and API-Pin. Returns `{data: [{id, slug, name, role}, ...]}`,
`role` being `owner` or your membership's role (co_builder, contributor, guest),
and `slug` the world's public page address, or null.
name: list_worlds
